   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": "# 2D hydrogen storage in an aquifer\n\nUse the existing structural-trap aquifer model for hydrogen build-up and five storage cycles. Gravity, capillarity, and tabulated dissolution are active. The bundled deck uses zero added salt; diffusion and PHREEQC are disabled."
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "id": "run-example",
   "metadata": {},
   "execution_count": null,
   "outputs": [],
   "source": "startupH2sim\nresult = exampleBlackOilAquifer2D('numCycles', 5);\n\n% Redraw saved accepted states.\nplotBlackOilAquifer2D(result, 'outputDirectory', ...\n    fullfile(pwd, 'build', 'aquifer-figures'));\nstate = result.states{end};\ngasSaturation = state.s(:, 2);\nsolutionRatio = state.rs;"
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "read-plots",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": "## Plume and well response\n\n![Hydrogen plume snapshots](attachment:aquifer_plume.png)\n\n![Well response](attachment:aquifer_well_response.png)\n\nThe 50 m × 50 m grid has a 2 m target spacing. The 500-day schedule includes 120 days of build-up, a 30-day shut-in, and five 70-day cycles. Each cycle contains 30 days of injection, 10 days idle, and 30 days withdrawal. Plume panels share a color scale. `result.packedProblem` identifies the setup and accepted outputs on disk.",
   "attachments": {
    "aquifer_plume.png": {
     "image/png": ""
    },
    "aquifer_well_response.png": {
     "image/png": ""
    }
   }
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": "## Hydrogen loss due to dissolution\n\nThe dissolved share is $100 V_{\\mathrm{diss}}/(V_{\\mathrm{diss}}+V_{\\mathrm{free}})$, with $V_{\\mathrm{diss}}=\\sum_c PV_c S_{l,c} b_{l,c}R_{s,c}$ and $V_{\\mathrm{free}}=\\sum_c PV_c S_{g,c}b_{g,c}$. All volumes use the same surface conditions. This measures partitioning out of the free-gas inventory, rather than irreversible consumption or cumulative loss of injected hydrogen. Pressure decline can release dissolved hydrogen.\n\n![Dissolved hydrogen and dissolved share over five cycles](attachment:aquifer_dissolution.png)",
   "attachments": {
    "aquifer_dissolution.png": {
     "image/png": ""
    }
   },
   "id": "aquifer-dissolution"
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": "## Inspect the fluid tables\n\nThese pressure-dependent properties come from the existing aquifer input tables, over 30–50 bar. They are not newly generated NIST data.\n\n```matlab\nplotAquiferFluidTables(result);\n```\n\n![Aquifer black-oil PVT properties](attachment:aquifer_fluid_tables.png)",
